verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scoping API keys to a group/role (e.g. Workspace viewer) so an AI tool doesn't get admin access, directly matching the least-privilege credential story, and permissions/approvals/ownership boundaries are also documented. However, there's no detail on granular scopes beyond group-role assignment, no token expiration/rotation controls, and no independent corroboration of this feature in practice. Missing for 10: fine-grained scope definitions beyond group roles, credential expiry/rotation support, third-party validation of least-privilege enforcement.
